mapper.select: SELECT R.*, M.nickName as extra__writer FROM reply R JOIN `member` M ON R.memberId = M.id WHERE articleId = #{articleId} ORDER BY regDate DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `reply` set memberId = #{memberId}, articleId = #{articleId}, body = #{body}
mapper.update: UPDATE reply SET body = #{body}, updateDate = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
